eligibility_gates.rule: all handbook 12.2 fields present and frozen; sham-calendar control present AND runnable under evidenced semantics for any calendar-conditioned arm (an unrunnable sham is a design failure, plan section 4 D2)
max |rho| vs ALL forbidden ancestry (V5 window-avoidance + sham shadow + carry region + session families + commodity-bloc risk-off) <= 0.20, measured by A7 at D2; margin recorded per P-2

each of the 3 folds carries >= 30 qualifying decisions for EVERY arm (anchor, neighbour, control); sham/control event count >= 50% of anchor count (control identifiability); all conditioning traced to p3_conditioning_clocks_v6.json shas or staged-snapshot observables; AU gaps and CA boundary rows respected
no data outside data_raw/forex_free_v1 + the clocks file; lane 2 unfundable (carried)

ranking_among_eligible: 1. lowest measured max-|rho| (novelty margin, bigger is safer)
2. information-source independence from the other candidate family
